7 Brew Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda is about $3.50, with 270 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 69 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Is there a sugar-free Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda?

Yes — 7 Brew lists a sugar-free version built with sugar-free syrups. Comparing mediums (iced):

VersionCaloriesSugarCarbsCaffeine
Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda27069 g70 g0 mg
Sugar-free Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda00 g1 g0 mg

Caffeine does not change — only the syrup does. See every sugar-free option in the customization guide.

Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Peaches 'n Cream Fizz at Home

Peach and vanilla over sparkling water. The cream decision is yours, because at the stand it is a topping, not part of the drink.

For one medium fizz

  • 1/2 oz peach syrup
  • 1/2 oz vanilla syrup
  • 10 to 12 oz plain sparkling water
  • A full cup of ice
  • Your call: nothing on top (the standard), 1 to 2 spoonfuls of cream, or whipped cream
  1. Both syrups over the ice.
  2. Sparkling water in slow, one gentle stir.
  3. Add the cream or whipped cream last if you are using it, so it floats instead of vanishing.

Sugar-free at home: sugar-free peach and vanilla syrups get you the published version's whole point, a true zero. Peach-forward: shift the split toward peach if the vanilla is reading too much like candy. The stand's exact split is not published, so tune it to your glass.

7 Brew Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda?

A medium iced Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda has 270 calories. A small has 180 and a large 360, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda?

0 mg. No fizz has caffeine, whatever a few fan tables claim.

How much does a 7 Brew Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Peaches 'n Cream 7 Fizz Soda?

69 g in a medium, or 0 g if you order the sugar-free version.

Is there actual cream in a Peaches 'n Cream Fizz?

No. The standard build is peach syrup and vanilla syrup in sparkling water, and that is the whole ingredient list. The nutrition gives it away: 0 g of fat. The cream in the name is the impression the vanilla leaves, like a cream soda. Actual cream, whipped cream and cold foam are all toppings you can add, and plenty of people do. Just know that the moment you add them, it is a different drink on paper too.

Is this the sweetest fizz on the menu?

Yes. A medium iced is 270 calories and 69 g of sugar, the heaviest of the named fizzes. Blood Orange, Brew Lagoon and Sunrise sit at 250, Pink Mermaid at 240. A large Peaches 'n Cream runs 360 calories and 92 g of sugar, which is milkshake-adjacent territory for a soda. It earns it, flavor-wise. Just order it knowing it is dessert, not a light refreshment.

How good is the sugar-free version, really?

It is one of the best sugar-free deals on the whole menu. Sugar-Free Peaches 'n Cream is a real published drink, not a syrup swap you have to hope for: 0 calories and 0 g of sugar in kids, small and medium, and 5 calories in a large. Only two named fizzes got a published sugar-free version, this one and Sunrise. One catch, and it matters: the zero only holds if you skip the creamy toppings. Cream runs about 40 calories an ounce, so a creamy sugar-free build is low-calorie, not zero. The full list is on our sugar-free drinks page.

Do 7 Fizz drinks have a little caffeine, like some tables say?

No. Zero, all of them, every size. One popular guide's comparison table lists fizzes at 5, 20, even 50 mg of caffeine depending on the flavor. Those numbers are invented. The official guide's caffeine column for the entire fizz section is 0, because the base is sparkling water. If a table gives a fizz any caffeine at all, its calorie numbers are probably made up too. That same table is off on those by 150 calories or more.

Is Peaches 'n Cream Fizz a good evening or kids' drink?

It is built for exactly that. No caffeine means a 7 pm cup does not touch anyone's sleep, and the Facebook groups are full of people ordering it late for that reason. The thing to watch is sugar, not caffeine: a regular medium carries 69 g. For kids, the sugar-free version or a half-sweet regular keeps the peaches-and-cream flavor without the full dessert load.
